questions.stem: Find the $n$th term of the sequence $2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ...$.
questions.explanation: First differences: $4, 6, 8, 10$. Second differences: $2, 2, 2$. So $a = 1$ (since $2a = 2$). Subtract $n^2$: $2-1, 6-4, 12-9, 20-16, 30-25 = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5$. This is $n$. So the $n$th term is $n^2 + n$.
